title: Cordoba amazing tour
text: Fantastic tour of Córdoba!! Our guide Alexis was super knowledgeable and kind. Had a great day
author: W8890VOmartinad

title: Superb
text:
We had a great time exploring Córdoba! The city is beautiful, full of history, and the Mosque-Cathedral was absolutely incredible.
Our tour guide Luca was fantastic, friendly, knowledgeable, and made the tour fun with lots of interesting facts and stories. He kept everything well organized and was happy to answer questions along the way. I would highly  recommend this tour
author: Rinu_K

title: Good visit in Cordoba
text: Alexis is a spectacular guide. He kept an eye on us at all times, gave us a lot of information and told us some curiosities about Cordoba and its people. In addition, he recommended places to eat that are very worthwhile.  Tour with Alexis recommended 100%.
author: Explorer572774

title: Fantastic
text: We went with Alexis to discover the wonderful city of Cordoba, a pleasure to be able to do it with his unrivalled company, expert guide, friendly, always watching over us, who has made us live the best sightseeing tour of our lives, explaining history, gastronomy, culture ... Thanks to Alexis for everything
author: anamM3735GU

title: The best visit

title: I'd like to do it again.
text: Cordoba is fantastic, and the driving was superb. He accompanied me step by step, and provided me with invaluable information
author: Angelo_R

title: Wonderful well informed...
text: Wonderful well informed guide. Lovely out of the way spots in Cordoba. We loved the garden tour. The Alcázar guide was exceptional.
author: Mary_B

title: Wonderful trip to Cordoba
text: This is a wonderful private tour with extremely knowledgeable guides, very relaxing and nice not having to go with a heard of people. You have the guides all to yourself so you can hear without a microphone and ask questions. Highly recommend!
author: Christina_P

title: Amazing tour
text: Awesome tour! Alexi knows his history and was an amazing guide, we had a lot of fun and was really nice having a private drive to and from Sevilla. We highly recommend this tour!
author: Christina P

title: Our guide Enrique was...
text: Our guide Enrique was wonderful. He possesses a diverse knowledge of the history of the area and eagerly shared it with us, and answering our many questions. Loved the patios and the Cathedral/Mosque was absolutely amazing. Highly recommend this tour.
author: Sue_P
